title: HeyGen Launches Voice Model on OpenRouter and Design Arena
summary:
The AI startup's in-house speech tool is now available via two new partners, providing a low-latency 'Turbo' option for developers. On OpenRouter, HeyGen Voice costs $15 per 1 million characters and the Turbo version is $7.50 per 1 million characters, both of which are 50% off their list prices through October 31. The model has also been integrated into the Design Arena platform for conversational assistants and customer service applications.

HeyGen Voice is the company's first native text-to-speech model and currently ranks first on the Artificial Analysis Controlled Voice TTS Arena with an Elo of 1,201. It has outperformed Alibaba's Qwen-Audio-3.1-TTS-Plus and ElevenLabs' Eleven v4 Turbo in blind tests, particularly in UK English and assistant roles. While it generates 40 characters per second and ranks 10th for overall pronunciation robustness at 83.1%, it placed second for preserving exact text sequences.

selectedTweets.text:
HeyGen Voice takes the #1 spot on the Artificial Analysis Controlled Voice TTS Arena Leaderboard, ahead of Alibaba's Qwen-Audio-3.1-TTS-Plus and ElevenLabs' Eleven v4 Turbo

HeyGen Voice is the first Text to Speech model from @HeyGen evaluated in our Controlled Voice Arena, where models are evaluated using the same 8 cloned voices across US and UK English.

Key takeaways:

➤ Controlled Voice: HeyGen Voice has an Elo of 1,201 across 1,468 arena appearances, placing it ahead of Qwen-Audio-3.1-TTS-Plus at 1,182, Eleven v4 Turbo at 1,166 and Eleven v4 at 1,162. It ranks #1 in Assistants and Customer Service, #2 in Knowledge Sharing and #1 in English (UK).

➤ Pronunciation Robustness: HeyGen Voice scores 83.1%, ranking #10 of 29 models, behind Qwen-Audio-3.1-TTS-Plus at 84.6% and ahead of Inworld Realtime TTS-2 at 80.7%. It ranks #2 in Preserving Exact Sequences at 83.3%, behind only SpaceXAI TTS.

➤ Pricing: HeyGen Voice is priced at $30/1M characters, compared to Qwen-Audio-3.1-TTS-Plus at $19.3/1M characters, Eleven v4 Turbo at $40/1M characters and Eleven v4 at $80/1M characters.

➤ Speed: HeyGen Voice processes 40 characters per second of generation time, compared to 76 characters per second for Eleven v4 and 46 for Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS.
